notes.title: Progress update!
notes.notes:
Apologies for the long silence. I have still been working on the game, and I still plan on finishing it!

Currently, here's where things are at:


Planets: 70%

Items: 75%

Game Systems: 75%

Character Skins: 90%

Balancing: 70%

UI (User Interface) and Miscellaneous: 80%



I'll continue to update as I make progress. A huge thanks to everyone that has offered their thoughts and feedback (both good and bad), I really appreciate it!
